marco_csm: Heads up — QuasarBank onboarding metrics showed cost creep during last week's marketing spike and a few >700ms tails. Renewal conversation in 5 weeks. Want to propose a rapid pilot: int8 quant + compact-model swap for peak routing, plus KV-prefix cache for known templates. Need engineering + ML ops signoff.

anya_ml: Sounds reasonable. For Quasar's generation-heavy endpoints we saw <3% quality delta in our bench with int8 when we preserved layernorm FP32. Recommend a tiny calibration sample (128-256) from their anonymized prompts. Also keep a small A/B set with multi-turn context on float32.

devon_engineer: I can stand up the canary. Prefer traffic phasing: 3% -> 15% -> 40% over 48-72h with automated rollback triggers. Which metrics to gate on? p95 latency, error-rate, word-token perplexity delta?

tara_ops: Gate on p95 (<400ms target), error-rate increase <0.2%, and customer QA score (we'll run automatic BLEU-like spotchecks on known-good outputs). Also add an hourly digest for the customer-facing dashboard.

marco_csm: For the dashboard, include cost per 1k tokens, p95, and a small sample table of customer prompts with before/after snippets. We'll present this in the renewal deck if pilot looks good.

anya_ml: Quant profile to test: `{"quant":"int8","calibration_samples":192,"per_channel":true,"preserve_layernorm":true}`. We'll run internal eval suite on their top-150 prompts to flag hallucination regressions.

devon_engineer: Routing policy suggestion: latency_pref with compact fallback. Example snippet for routing config as a string in app: ```json
{"route_name":"quasar_peak","policy":"latency_pref","fallback_model":"redwood-compact-s","max_cost_usd_per_1k":1.8,"regions":["us-east-1","us-west-2"]}```

deploy_bot: Canary launched: quasar-int8-canary-3790000000 id=canary-9921. Initial traffic=3%. Monitors: p95 latency, cost_delta, auto-bleu, error_rate.

lucy_csm: I've booked a 30-minute joint review with QuasarBank for Tue 9am ET to walk through the plan and capture their SLOs and top prompt list. I'll ask them to anonymize a 200-sample set.

marco_csm: Risk note for renewal: they called out requiring "predictable latency during promos" in the last touchpoint. This pilot + fallback policy should address it but we need clean metric story. Capture any customer quality feedback precisely.

anya_ml: After 48h we'll produce an A/B diff report (metrics + spot-check examples). If quality delta is trivial and p95 improves, recommend bump to 15% and schedule compact-model fallback for peak hours.

devon_engineer: Logged infra tasks `#canary-quasar-9921` and added rollout playbook with rollback thresholds. I'll enable autoscale margin + KV-prefix caching for their top 20 templates during the pilot.

marco_csm: tagging @anya_ml @devon_engineer @lucy_csm 1 confirm readiness by Mon EOD so we can show the customer progress on Tue.

lucy_csm: Confirmed 1 will send prompt samples by Mon noon.

tara_ops: Ops note 1 set min replicas=3 for canary windows and enable trace sampling at 10% to capture latent tails.

marco_csm: Great work team 1 let9s capture all feedback in the renewal playbook and iterate the quant profile if needed. :rocket:
